Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting retailers from charging restocking fees on returned merchandise that is defective or damaged.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to restocking fees; and adding a new section tochapter 19.86 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.86 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No retailer may charge a restocking fee if the merchandise thatis to be returned or exchanged is defective or damaged. (2) As used in this section, "restocking fee" means a fee chargedby a retailer for the return or exchange of merchandise.
